turns.assessment: The entire S05→S09 OMS lost all channels, and even the booster amp0 input disappeared. Therefore the initiating loss is before amp0, not at amp1 or on a downstream fibre span. Unchanged pump currents across all five amplifiers strongly reject amplifier failure; the hard, all-channel loss and recent S05 maintenance point to a disconnected/broken OMS input patch at S05.

proposals.rationale: A pulled patch between the S05 ROADM degree and the S05→S09 booster removes every channel at amp0 input, producing the observed loss at the inputs and outputs of all downstream amplifiers. Recent maintenance at S05 increases its likelihood.
